# G03 shared physical usage handoff

Status: implementation and focused source/caller verification complete; root owns combined acceptance, runtime/server emit, architecture baseline lowering, roadmap and commits. No external model calls, commits, pushes, or historical evidence edits performed by this slice.

## Shared contracts and authority

- Dedicated `@napier/contracts/model-accounting` export defines attribution, admitted-input capture, immutable final observation, frozen provider/Run accounting bases and canonical summaries.
- `physicalId` identifies one admitted Models API invocation; it does not count hidden HTTP/provider retries.
- `knownBudgetCostUsd` is required in ModelAccountingSummaryV1 to retain known priced subtotal while `budgetCostUsd` is null. Resource/browser own fold and budget consumers; final contract emit must include it.
- Provider prices, Run prices, reported usage, budget estimates, and host reserves stay separate. Positive partial counters remain visible. Unknown price is null.
- Normal observation contains bounded primitive counters, allowlisted diagnostic metadata and response digest, never response text/tool content. Missing/final unknown cannot later be replaced known. Exact final duplicate only.
- Fresh undispatched-zero insertion requires private WeakMap authority bound to the exact object and content digest returned by `createUndispatchedModelObservation`, which requires driver proof. JSON/structuredClone copies and rehashed mutation cannot create new zero receipts. Persisted exact duplicates/replay remain accepted and revalidated.

## Durability

- `ModelUsageReceiptSpool.attach` participates in caller SQLite transaction; standalone `open` uses WAL/FULL and 0600 regular file.
- Reservations bind persisted source identity, workspace ledger, host workspace and attribution hash/JSON. Source metadata and indexed fields are checked on read.
- Verified delivery uses private WeakMap capability and rereads backing reservation/receipt every time, including Store CAS retry.
- Duplicate record and ACK reread/verify receipt within write transaction; metadata/index/digest/deletion/copy tamper tests exist.
- Source ACK follows Store claim in runtime and host orchestration. Source itself has no execution authority.

## Caller integration

- Run-owned context compaction preview/workbench and model invocation experiments bind the target Run lease, use completeModelInvocation and preserve physical linkage on normal/error logical response. Source Run unchanged.
- Replan, blueprint outcome and subagent outcome reviews use distinct operation-owned attribution, avoiding charge to completed source Run/Task.
- Pure adapter receipt/options/validator extraction into model-adapter-receipt removed dependency cycle/coupling; public old reexports preserved.
- Registry runtime setup extracted into model-registry-runtime; catalog API remains ModelRegistry. This reduces its coupling without budget increase.

## Verification (overlapping reports; do not add totals)

- `/tmp/napier-model-usage-final-v11-20261030.json`: 51/51, 9 files. Includes source/normalization, adapters, registry, three reviews, compaction workbench and model experiments.
- Native Run assertions verify one phase-specific receipt, exact target Run owner/linkage, positive actual provider token counts projected once, unchanged source Run, ACK and no pending source rows. Faux provider emits positive tokens/zero tariff, so expected result is partial with unknown budget price.
- `/tmp/napier-model-usage-proof-fix-v13-20261030.json`: 22/22, shared2 files after latest private-zero proof fix (supersedes shared20 inside v11).
- `/tmp/napier-model-usage-strict-types-v8-20261030.json`: expanded strict test config; `/tmp/napier-model-usage-strict-types-v13-20261030.log` empty/pass, before required knownBudgetCostUsd field addition. Root/resource must recheck after contract emit.
- Source suite includes real SIGKILL after reserve and receipt commit, reopen replay/ACK, and two simultaneous independent processes writing same receipt.
- `/tmp/napier-model-usage-proof-audit-red-20261030.json`: intentional red demonstrating copied zero DTO was accepted by host source before fix. New `apps/server/test/workspace-model-usage-authority-audit.test.ts` asserts it is rejected and active/debit remain; root must rerun after its next runtime emit.
- `/tmp/napier-model-usage-architecture-v11-20261030.log`: shared/caller/registry slice has no own architecture violation or new cycle; other owners were still extracting and lowering stale overrides. Latest observation 450 lines, validation496, experiments496, blueprint491. No budgets raised.
- Owned `git diff --check` clean; trailing model-adapters EOF blank removed.

## Independent audit of root host/auxiliary slice

Found and fixed copied-zero authority bypass above (confirmed red before fix).
Otherwise inspected source/host transaction ordering, retry preservation, recovery identity/ledger checks, accounting-only Store reopen, native evaluation failures and compactor output fencing. Physical settlement and receipt share host tx; Store claim precedes ACK/refund; recovery constructs no provider/runtime; native evaluator throws receipt/dispatch failures before save; compactor errors return no summary. Existing root host/process tests cover terminal invariance; no redundant rerun claimed.

Caveat noted to root: configureSource validates all pending ledger identities before recovery per-row loop, so a wrong-ledger row blocks the batch before valid-sibling handling. Fail-closed behavior matches current wrong-ledger test; comment promising no sibling starvation is broader than actual behavior.

## Owned files

New production: packages/contracts/src/model-accounting.ts; packages/runtime/src/model-usage-validation.ts, model-usage-observation.ts, model-usage-source.ts, model-usage-delivery.ts, model-adapter-receipt.ts, model-registry-runtime.ts.

Shared edited: packages/contracts/package.json; packages/runtime/src/internal.ts, model-adapters.ts, models.ts.

Delegated edited callers: packages/runtime/src/replan-review.ts, blueprint-outcome-review.ts, subagent-outcome-review.ts, context-compaction-preview-model.ts, context-compaction-workbench.ts, model-invocation-experiments.ts.

New tests/helpers: packages/runtime/test/model-usage-fixture.ts, model-usage-observation.test.ts, model-usage-source.test.ts, model-usage-source-worker.ts, model-usage-review-fixture.ts, model-usage-registry-fixture.ts; apps/server/test/workspace-model-usage-authority-audit.test.ts.

Edited tests: packages/runtime/test/replan-review.test.ts, blueprint-outcome-review.test.ts, subagent-outcome-review.test.ts, context-compaction-workbench.test.ts, model-invocation-experiments.test.ts.

Child browser_capacity_seams owns attribution/admission/driver/capture/session/main/child/runtime bootstrap changes and its new dispatch test file. Resource owns canonical Store/fold/SQL/import/accounting revisions. Root owns server/evaluation/run compactor/recovery and final acceptance.
